questions.stem: Mei Ling looked at the clock in the bus interchange. What time does the clock show?

explain.why: Counted one mark too far on the minute hand.
Read the hour for the next hour mark.
Read the hour hand as the minute hand and the minute hand as the hour hand.

solution: The short hand points near 11, so the hour is 11.
The long hand points to 3, so 15 minutes past.
